annotation.interpretation_a: Protocol mapping documents are permitted, but not required, to add labels.
annotation.interpretation_b: Protocol mapping documents are permitted to add multiple labels, or no labels at all.
annotation.justification: The clause uses "MAY", granting discretion, but does not constrain *how many* additional labels can be prepended. This allows for implementations that add zero, one, or multiple labels, all of which are reasonable interpretations of the text.
